Specifically, the scope of the work is for dataflow applications related to Program Preparation, Program Selection, Observation Preparation, Operations Support and Science Archive. The contract will be structured around defined testing services using an agile process with roughly one to two months iteration cycles. At the end of each cycle the testing service for the next cycle will be agreed. The technical focus of this service contract is on testing Java and web-based applications for the VLT/ELT and ALMA dataflow systems. The contractor should have as a minimum the following experience/capabilities: · Familiarity with Agile software development process · Solid practical familiarity with modern software engineering practices and tools, including configuration control tools, incremental & iterative development, unit and integration testing and the Linux environment · Demonstrated experience with configuration management tools, preferably SVN and Git · Demonstrated experience with issue management systems, and continuous integration systems (e.g. Jenkins) · Proven experience of Unit test frameworks like Junit or TestNG · Very good knowledge of testing REST API applications · Good knowledge of Java software development · Good knowledge of testing dynamic web applications, including Javascript-centric single page applications (e.g. Angular applications) · Good experience in testing tools like Selenium · Significant experience with relational databases and SQL · Good knowledge of test automation · Good knowledge of testing Java Desktop GUIs under Linux and/or MacOS · Good knowledge of scripting languages, preferably Groovy and/or Python The contract is foreseen to have an initial duration of three years, with an option for an extension of up to two years. The estimated effort is about 4 FTEs per year for the initial 3 years period. The Call for Tender/Price Inquiry is scheduled to be issued in Q1/Q2 2020 to companies in ESO Member States. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q4/2020, to the Bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant Tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer. title: T709-809GD ADVANCED COMPUTER VISION METHODS FOR OBJECT DETECTION, CLASSIFICATION ANDSEGMENTATION ON OPTICAL SENSORS IMAGES (EXPRO+)
description: Numerous observations of the sky take place on a daily basis from distributed ground-based andspace-based optical sensors. Typically, faint streak-like features are generated in the images dueto the small size of the objects and relative observation geometry. The detection and segmentationof low signal-to-noise (SNR) ratio streaks poses a major challenge to state-of-the-art tools.Depending on the configured sensitivity in processing tools, it can generate a large number of falsepositive detections. The false detections are caused by artifacts generated by different factors likeoversaturation caused by bright stars, bad pixels or cosmic rays. Similarly, detection, classification,segmentation and tracking of objects like sunspot groups on solar images is a key component foranalysis/forecasting and reaction strategies. For example, reliable knowledge on current activeregions is a crucial factor that can influence Space Weather prediction. However a large challengeof the existing data sources is the large imbalance in class distribution.This activity aims at identifying AI methods to segment such images into background (includingstars etc.) and features, deal with class imbalances, but also to report on the detection probabilityin order to quantify the detection limit for the use of the data to validate existing models. Variousprocessing approaches shall be considered including offline, but also near real-time, as well asconstrained environments for the deployment of AI models like on-board a spacecraft. Anotheraspect that is aimed to be investigated is the digital fusing of data and observations from distributedsensors (e.g. ground and space based telescopes or constellations) and its' correlation. Finally,explainable AI solutions shall be offered for all the algorithms, in order to increase thetrustworthiness of the output predictions for the end-users. T he output of this activity shall contributeto all missions addressing theimprovements of both ground and space based analysis of faintimages.

Přístroje musí splňovat minimální technické podmínky specifikované zadavatelem v technické specifikaci pro jednotlivé části veřejné zakázky. Pro část č. 1 platí, že v rámci technických parametrů uvedených v příloze č. 1 a) zadávací dokumentace je u parametrů, které nejsou definovány max., min. či rozmezím, umožněna odchylka +- 10% od požadované pevné hodnoty. Zadavatel požaduje dodávku nových přístrojů, nepřipouští možnost dodávky repasovaných přístrojů.
